{"candidate":{"files":[{"path":"engine.py","text":"def solve(data):
    packages = data['packages']
    roots = data['roots']
    names = sorted(packages)
    bounds = roots
    best_vector = None
    best_versions = None

    def candidates(name):
        low, high = bounds[name] if name in bounds else (None, None)
        rows = packages.get(name, [])
        return [row for row in rows
                if name not in bounds or low <= row['version'] <= high]

    def search(required, selected):
        nonlocal best_vector, best_versions
        pending = required - selected.keys()
        if not pending:
            vector = tuple(selected.get(name, -1) for name in names)
            if best_vector is None or vector > best_vector:
                best_vector = vector
                best_versions = dict(selected)
            return

        # Choose the most constrained pending package first.
        name = min(pending, key=lambda item: len(candidates(item)))
        for row in candidates(name):
            version = row['version']
            next_selected = dict(selected)
            next_selected[name] = version
            next_required = set(required)
            next_required.update(row.get('deps', []))
            search(next_required, next_selected)

    search(set(roots), {})
    if best_versions is None:
        return {'error': 'unsatisfiable'}
    return {'versions': best_versions}
